question: How to Fix Common PLC Analog Input Problems?
body_html:
PLC analog input problems are usually caused by wiring, grounding, noise, scaling or configuration, not by a faulty transmitter or card.

SymptomLikely causeFix
Always zeroBroken wire, no loop powerCheck 24 V DC and continuity
FluctuatingNoise, poor shield groundingShielded twisted pair, ground one end
Wrong valueWrong scalingRescale raw to engineering units

For 0 to 10 bar, 12 mA scales to (12 − 4) × (10 ÷ 16) = 5 bar.
